Gatwick Airport Expansion Proceeds After Legal Challenge Fails

Campaigners have failed in their bid to stop Gatwick Airport from operating a second runway. The Court of Appeal dismissed their application, with judges describing the challenge as "unarguable". The £2.2 billion expansion project will allow for approximately 100,000 additional flights annually. Local campaign groups had sought to halt the two-runway operation.
